title: Jesus... Why Do You Make Me Wait?

bible.text: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus. So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do You make me wait when You know how badly I need You? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've been praying for this for so long. You know how much it hurts to keep waiting.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. And I know every moment you've spent wondering why I haven't moved yet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if You love me, why didn't You come sooner?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: There was a time when Lazarus was sick, and I could have gone immediately. But I waited.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Even though You knew he was suffering?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. My delay did not mean My love had disappeared. What looked like silence was not the end of the story.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So when You don't answer when I expect... it doesn't mean You've forgotten me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. Waiting can make you feel forgotten, but My timing is not proof of My absence. Keep trusting Me, even when you cannot see what I am doing. 🤍

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sometimes you see the delay. I see the whole story. Don't mistake My silence for the end.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What are you waiting for God to do? ⏳ Leave a 🙏 if you're still choosing to trust Him.
